mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating accommodative monetary policy) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 0.5% month-over-month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains stable or falls, the market anticipates delayed monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high housing starts (HOUST > 700.0 thousand units) indicate overbought market conditions and potential economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (MoM > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index, 2017=100) signals an economic contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) rise above 0.5% month-over-month and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, the market perceives strong consumer demand and inflationary pressures, leading to expectations of Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic expansion regime, quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% (annualized).
